content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: The state legislature has overwhelmingly approved a new tax bill that includes significant changes to the sales tax structure, drawing criticism from some lawmakers and business owners.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Proponents of the bill argue that it will modernize the state’s tax system and generate much-needed revenue for education and infrastructure projects.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Opposition leader Michael Davis stated, 'This bill is a blatant attempt to shift the burden onto working families.'

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: The bill now goes to the governor for final approval, where it faces potential veto.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Business groups are divided, with some welcoming the changes as necessary and others warning of economic repercussions.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
